status: scientific lock: ambiguity-robust rollback frontiers for the positive packet-chain fragment
purpose: validate the rollback-transversal theorem, its exact downward-closure boundary, certificate checker, structured algorithms, and retained negative controls
randomness: Only the structured random family uses fixed local seeds; exhaustive suites are lexicographic. No tuning or held-out performance claim.

frontier_exhaustive.included_instances: every inclusion antichain of subsets that does not contain the empty cause, including the empty frontier
checks_per_frontier: declared frontier equals trace-enumerated minimal bad states
compositional antichain denotation equals operational deviation on every hidden commit set
exact minimum support and optimality certificate agree with brute force
every candidate support agrees between full ambiguity-cube replay and transversal test
interval greedy agrees with brute force when every edge is an interval
frontier_exhaustive.falsifier: any semantic, brute-force, certificate, transversal, regression, or interval mismatch

monotonicity_boundary.predicates: all 32,768 truth tables whose all-old reference is good
checks: downward closure iff endpoint correctness equals ambiguity robustness for every support
for downward-closed predicates, frontier transversals equal both semantic notions
for a nonmonotone predicate, retain a good endpoint, bad reachable subset, and support witness
monotonicity_boundary.falsifier: one predicate for which the exact characterization or frontier equivalence fails

structured_benchmarks.interpretation: deterministic solver/certificate stress cases; not production representativeness or throughput
structured_benchmarks.falsifier: checker rejection, endpoint failure, disagreement with brute force where feasible, or interval disagreement

certificate_mutations: replace the support by one that misses a cause
change bound or malformed key sets
legacy certificate mutations for omitted observations and successors

retained_finite_game_baseline.role: negative control and boundary outside the monotone reset fragment
retained_finite_game_baseline.claim_boundary: established bounded belief-game search; not the new synthesis result

nonclaims: no production network, device, traffic trace, throughput, or latency evidence
no recovery-time failures, concurrency, in-flight packets, or unrestricted negation in the positive fragment
no claim that structured family savings predict operational savings
no claim that antichain provenance or hitting-set optimization is itself new
